meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、调整频道归属、设置隔离级别，并显示所有频道和用户权限的概览。
howto.when: 当你需要配置或重新组织消息频道与智能体组的对应关系时触发，例如添加新频道后、初始设置期间，或单独运行以重新配置。

say.text: 帮我查看当前频道和智能体组的连接情况。
say.note: Claude 会读取数据库并展示配置摘要。

say.text: 把 Slack 频道 #general 连接到销售智能体组。
say.note: Claude 会询问隔离模式并执行注册命令。

say.text: 添加一个新的 Telegram 群组，连接到现有智能体。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成配对和注册流程。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage the connection between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, reassign channels, set isolation levels, and display an overview of all channels and user permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to configure or reorganize the mapping of messaging channels to agent groups, e.g., after adding a new channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

say_en.text: Show me the current channel and agent group connections.
say_en.note: Claude reads the database and displays a configuration summary.

say_en.text: Connect the Slack channel #general to the sales agent group.
say_en.note: Claude asks about isolation mode and runs the register command.

say_en.text: Add a new Telegram group and connect it to an existing agent.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through pairing and registration.
